phrase: Attributes of Instances, Instance Headers, and Mosaics

attrs.name: blockages
attrs.desc: List all blockages that exist in the instance.

attrs.name: clusters
attrs.desc: List of all clusters that exist in the instance.

attrs.name: conns
attrs.desc: List of all connected instance terminals for this instance (applicable only if the instance is not a mosaic).

attrs.name: mag
attrs.desc: Magnification for the instance. Always = 1.0. Magnification of instances is not supported.

attrs.name: physOnly
attrs.desc: When t, the instance data is physical rather than physical and logical. When a cellview is written from SoCE, the cellview contains EMH data and is physical and logical. Instances inherit this physOnly status from the cellview.

attrs.name: source
attrs.desc: The different sources you can assign to an instance. Valid Values: netlist timing dist test user

attrs.name: status
attrs.desc: Status of this instance for placement

attrs.name: transform

attrs.name: xy
attrs.desc: xy location of the instance (in user units).
